integration.scope: Photo-inspired cosmetic exterior game asset; chosen game proportions, not measured construction data. No functioning weapon, electronics or propulsion internals.
integration.bank_layout: 3 columns x 6 rows. Slot index is row-major from bow to stern, port to starboard.
integration.hatch_animation_units: Local X degrees relative to closed rest pose. 0 closed, +100 open.
notes: No drones standing on deck; 18 actual recessed, empty visual bays.
Payloads are separate mod entities/models and are not bundled.
Some below-water hull geometry and unseen details are artistic reconstruction.
Demo file is a static illustration with two open hatches; main file carries the animation clips.
Textures are embedded and also included as separate PNG files.
Rendering, placement, collision, buoyancy, inventory, networking and launching require mod implementation.
